name: Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro — husband Pietro Dondero and a daughter born 1883 at Genova
researcher_question: Was the Carmela Cavagnaro who bore a daughter, Maria Clementina Angelica Gentile Dondero, at Genova on 30 August 1883 with Pietro Dondero the same woman as Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro, born 1866 in Lima?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 21, hint-samples.csv row 640, flags adds_spouse/adds_daughter, confidence 3). Adjudicated as a FALSE MATCH (spec 3.6 outcome (c)). The subject's own documented marriage is to Paolo Andrea Vaglio, 26 Jul 1900 at Bogliasco (ark:/61903/1:1:X3L8-MFLR); read directly, that act names the bride born 1866 at Lima, Maestra Elementare, daughter of Giuseppe and Maddalena Bitano, which identifies G4Z4-RJ1. The Carmela Cavagnaro of the 1883 hint entry (ark:/61903/1:1:6BHW-1HG3) is a different woman, documented with Pietro Dondero at Genova in at least 1883 and 1891 (Attilio Omero Dondero, 31 May 1891, ark:/61903/1:1:X3TM-QPSS). Caveat for graders: the 1900 marriage post-dates both Dondero births and the indexed act carries no stato civile, so it does not on its own exclude an earlier marriage; reading the bride's civil status off the register image (ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L9WL-JC3N) would close that gap and was not done. No substitute husband or child was found for the subject. Her birth entry (ark:/61903/1:1:QVR6-Q9DC) gives 20 May 1866 at Genova, making her 17 in Aug 1883 and conflicting with the tree's Lima birthplace; that conflict is documented in the README and deliberately not graded. Her parents are Giuseppe Cavagnaro and Maddalena Boitano; Angelo Vaglio and Maria Fereccio are the GROOM's parents, attached to her in error from her own marriage record, and the three 'Vaglio' sources are that record and legitimately hers. Left uncorrected upstream; tracked in issue #2908. Second opinion: Ikennaya Mbadiwe. The batch CSV labels this row Peru; the records are Genovese and the fixture is tagged IT.
